title: Price the ordinary coupling gate and finite pulse occupation
statement: The ordinary finite cooling/damped-swap cycle proves exposure at every time, including during finite pulses, rather than inferring it from terminal transfer accuracy. Its conservative R>=512(Lambda+J+W) supplier gives v>1/2 for T>=1/W and the same conditional bracket scaling. It requires an actual gating/timing/slew port; an ordinary controller given only the literal always-on ports can instead run the root supplier itself with identical resources. Different sufficient rate constants do not establish a fixed-bandwidth or total-work advantage.

assumptions: Protected logical identity at the actual physical null, warranted error algebra/activity and coupling bounds, joint conditional preparation/readout error, an initial range and an actual cancellation reference accurate to order epsilon are supplied. Fixed logical dephasing or reference offset creates an accuracy floor. This is not arbitrary-material metrology, a full-record/channel equivalence or superiority over an equally supplied ordinary controller. Six originals are acquired; referenced exact review files, results and binary records are not. The failed Library save was not retried and no new ZIP is claimed.

All endpoint, holding, bath, reference and reset costs remain
